fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of a master's in computer science at Leeds? Here is what it costs, who can get in and the 2027 deadlines.

The Computer Science MSc is a **12-month**, full-time conversion course, taught on campus in Leeds. A conversion course teaches computing to graduates from other subjects. It starts in September 2027.

**The most important fact for you:** you need a degree in a subject that is not computer science. If you hold a BTech, BE or BCA in computer science, this course is not for you.

Compulsory modules are Fundamentals of Programming (30 credits), Computer Systems (15 credits) and Practical application of Artificial Intelligence (15 credits). You then choose four optional 15-credit modules, such as Database and Data Management, Software Engineering, Network Security and Defensive Practices, Web Development, Work-based Learning or Artificial Intelligence. Over the summer you do a **60-credit** project.

For the wider university, see our [University of Leeds page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-leeds).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need a bachelor degree with a 2:1 (hons) in any subject that is not computer science. A 2:1 is a UK honours grade. Leeds also encourages you to apply with a 2:2 and relevant work experience or professional qualifications, but an offer is not guaranteed.

**Indian marks.** Leeds' India page says that for a 2:1 you need First class (**60%**) or a CGPA of 6/10 (5/8, 4.2/7 or 3/4). For a 2:2 it lists Upper second class (**55%**) or a CGPA of 5.5/10.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. This course asks for **IELTS 6.5** overall, with no less than **6.0** in any component. Leeds runs pre-sessional English courses, on campus and online, if you need to raise your score.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Leeds's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

Tuition for international students is **£34,600** for the whole course, starting September 2027. The page lists it as the total fee.

Leeds is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, September 2027 | £34,600 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,203 × 9 months | £10,827 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£47,149** |

The sum is £34,600 + £10,827 + £558 + £1,164 = £47,149. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule for courses outside London rises from **£1,171** to **£1,203** a month for visa applications made on or after **30 November 2026**. A September 2027 student applies in 2027, so plan on **£1,203** for each month of your course, up to **9 months** (£10,827). You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row, and the 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** If you need a Student visa, you pay a tuition fee deposit of **£2,000** to receive your CAS. A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the electronic letter your visa application needs.

**Application fee.** No fee is listed on the course or apply pages.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

Two Leeds awards for September 2027 are open to Indian students on this course.

- **Masters International Regional Scholarship:** a **£6,000** fee reduction for Indian passport holders who pay international fees and are self- or partly-funded. It is automatic once you hold an offer. The page lists the deadline as ongoing.
- **Masters International Excellence Scholarship:** **£3,000**, **£6,000** or **£16,000** off tuition. You need an offer and a 2:1 or equivalent, and you fill in an application form. Round one closes on **28 February 2027** (results by 2 April 2027). Round two closes on **16 May 2027** (results by 11 June 2027). Leeds says to apply for the course at least one month before the scholarship deadline.

Read the full terms on the [Regional Scholarship page](https://www.leeds.ac.uk/scholarship/14/masters-international-regional-scholarships) and the [Excellence Scholarship page](https://www.leeds.ac.uk/scholarship/12/masters-international-excellence-scholarships).

## Deadlines and intakes

| Intake | Who applies | Deadline | Where to apply |
|---|---|---|---|
| September 2027 | International applicants | 30 July 2027 (typical Leeds date. Course date NOT CONFIRMED.) | University online application |

The course page does not print its own deadline. It points to the Leeds How to Apply page, which says international students typically apply by **30 July 2027** and that some courses close earlier. Apply early so you have time for the visa.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rule.** Make sure you meet the degree rule and have a 2:1 or equivalent.
2. **Prepare your documents.** You need your degree certificate and transcript (or a partial transcript), contact details for two academic references, a personal statement, an up-to-date CV, your English test result if you have one, and a letter of sponsorship if you need one.
3. **Apply online.** Use the Apply link on the [course page](https://courses.leeds.ac.uk/k299/computer-science-msc). You can apply before you take your English test.
4. **Apply for scholarships.** Submit the Excellence Scholarship form by your round deadline.
5. **Accept your offer and pay the deposit.** Pay the **£2,000** deposit. The university then issues your CAS.
6. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the course needs an ATAS certificate.
7. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.
- **Careers.** The course aims to prepare you for roles in the technology sector.

## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- your degree is in engineering (other than computer science), science, commerce, law or arts, and you want a tech career
- you have about 60% or a CGPA of 6/10 from your Indian university
- you hold an Indian passport and want the automatic **£6,000** Regional Scholarship

**Think carefully if:**

- your degree is in computer science, because the course is for graduates of other subjects
- you need a January start, because only September is listed

faq_json.q: Can I do the Leeds MSc Computer Science with a BTech in computer science?
faq_json.a: No. The course is a conversion course for graduates with a 2:1 in any subject that is not computer science.

faq_json.q: How much does the Leeds MSc Computer Science cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £34,600 for the whole course, starting September 2027. Adding visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge gives £47,149 for the year.

faq_json.q: What percentage do Indian students need?
faq_json.a: Leeds' India page says a 2:1 means First class (60%) or a CGPA of 6/10.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Yes. The Masters International Regional Scholarship gives £6,000 off fees to Indian passport holders, automatically. The Excellence Scholarship offers £3,000, £6,000 or £16,000 by application.

faq_json.q: Does Leeds need GRE or IELTS for this course?
faq_json.a: The course page does not mention GRE. It asks for IELTS 6.5 with no less than 6.0 in any component.
